sections.overall: Forbidden Door '26 continues the excellent run of AEW PPVs this year. This is the best form I can remember the company having, perhaps since 2021! 22 matches this week, so plenty of gains across the board. AEW is on fire and the wrestlers' ratings reflect this!
sections.mens: Will Ospreay vs Swerve Strickland main evented FB and was a top match to conclude the men's Owen Hart Tournament (8.9). Will is now at #3 and his reclaiming of the top male wrestler in AEW feels inevitable. Rated just as high was Kenny Omega vs Zack Sabre Jr. What a clash of styles that was! Moxley vs Bandido for the Continental Title also delivered, as did the huge 12 man steel cage match, which featured a plethora of talent. What a week!
sections.womens: It's awesome to report that the very top match of the week was Mercedes Mone vs Maya World (9.18). A great story throughout the women's Owen Hart Tournament. Both women's stock has risen; Mercedes moves to "gold" status once again and Maya to "bronze", joining a select group of women's wrestlers. Also earning that lofty status at #3 is Thekla - she once again delivered on the big stage. Bring on the All In Women's World match!
sections.menstag: The Young Bucks consolidated their #1 status with their PPV opener (7.66) but was miles off their best. Cage & Copeland vs The Dogs (Connors & Finlay), though fun was not in the same league as what we are accustomed to with the Men's Tag division. Meanwhile, FTR drop out of the rankings due to inactivity - the first time in ages. Let's hope they return soon!
sections.womenstag: It's a shame the champs were only on the Buy In (again?) but at least we were treated to Athena & Mone vs Hyan & World. A great Collision main event (7.9) that saw both teams and all four wrestlers elevated. Other teams are sorely needed, especially with Sisters Of Sin going inactive.
sections.trios: Finally the Trios Champions have been featured in a quality match! The steel cage 12 man (8.87) was not a straight Trios, which reduces the points gain for Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong, but a decent rise nonetheless. This was much more significant than their average title defense against the latest Opps combo on Collision and puts them straight up to #2. Long time top Trios team The Demand going inactive puts Young Bucks & Perry in the top spot by default.
